A1.justification: Both PDFs describe MotionCrafter and provide readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–D. The shorter bibliography in v2 changes pagination without removing supplementary material.

before.justification: V1 reports original geometry and scene-flow evaluations in Tables 1–2, ablations in Tables 3–7, and qualitative reconstruction results.

after.justification: V2 retains the original benchmark evaluations, ablations, and qualitative results, including those in the appendices.

M1.justification: The joint geometry-motion representation, VAE architecture, normalization, losses, and training procedures remain unchanged. V2's explicit main-text statement that deterministic training is the default repeats information already in v1 Appendix B.3.

E1.justification: Training sources in Table 8 and geometry/scene-flow evaluation datasets remain identical. Appendix coverage also retains ScanNet, GMU Kitchen, and the DAVIS qualitative examples.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains POMATO, both ST4RTrack modes, DELTA, and Zero-MSF with the same pose variants. Table 2 and supplementary visual comparisons retain their comparators. The newly cited TrackingWorld is not evaluated.

E3.justification: World-coordinate alignment, VGGT pose conversion, metrics, thresholds, training budgets, and evaluation settings are unchanged. The deterministic default clarified in v2 Section 3.3 was already stated in v1 Appendix B.3.

E4.justification: The normalization, VAE training, fusion, multimodal supervision, decoder-loss, and training-paradigm ablations in Tables 3–7 are retained unchanged. The supplementary qualitative cases are also identical.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests for the experimental results. No uncertainty-reporting practice is added or removed.

E6.justification: The numerical results and qualitative findings match throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1 retains MotionCrafter's Kubric Relp of 3.40 and EPE of 4.60; the deterministic-versus-diffusion results in Table 7 also remain identical.

T1.justification: The representation definitions, normalization and loss equations, coordinate transformations, and metric formulas are unchanged. V1's displayed Equation 8 becomes inline mathematics in v2, shifting subsequent equation numbers without altering their substance.

C1.justification: Both versions claim joint world-coordinate geometry and motion reconstruction, a unified 4D VAE, and effective transfer without strict latent alignment. The headline 38.64% geometry and 25.0% motion improvements remain unchanged; the video-generator terminology describes the existing framework.

C2.justification: Explanations of normalization and fusion benefits, weaker Sintel/DDAD performance, and the limitation concerning multimodal integration remain the same. The deterministic-performance summary added to Section 3.3 reiterates Appendix B.3's existing findings and interpretation.

D1.justification: SVD initialization, optimizer settings, iteration counts, loss weights, preprocessing, hardware, parameter counts, inference timing, and project access information are retained. The main-text default clarification adds no information beyond the existing appendix.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds TrackingWorld as a depth-prior-based 4D method. The introduction also explicitly names DUSt3R and MASt3R instead of using only a citation list. Remaining bibliography changes largely abbreviate venues or update publication metadata.

P1.justification: V2 polishes the abstract and passages throughout the main text, adjusts video-generator terminology, and makes the existing deterministic default more prominent. It also revises acknowledgments and the Section 4.1 heading. The narrative and section organization remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: V2 keeps the project link within the abstract's column, places the denoising-loss equation inline, and abbreviates bibliography entries, changing text flow and pagination. The eleven figures and eight tables retain their content and display structures.

improvement.justification: V2 improves clarity by stating the existing deterministic default directly in Section 3.3 and aligning high-level terminology with that configuration. Prose corrections and the cleaner first-page link layout further improve readability. The benefit is limited: the scientific method, experimental evidence, and limitations remain unchanged.
